skills.name: atk-logic
skills.description: Capture and decode digital timing with an ATK-Logic analyzer (ALIENTEK DL16/DL32) through the vendor's atk-logic-cli JSONL CLI. Provides a doctor/list/info device check, capability-driven frequency and duration selection (never guessing a legal combination), one capture with per-channel duty, edge and pulse statistics, repeated-capture series, ATKDL project reading, and CSV/VCD export for PulseView or sigrok. Also runs protocol decoding with the 209 sigrok decoders the ATK GUI ships (IR NEC/RC5/RC6/SIRC, UART/Modbus, I2C, SPI, CAN, SWD, 1-Wire, DHT11, WS2812), including multi-level stacks (uart+modbus, spi+spiflash), reading and writing the GUI's decode CSV. A capability matrix records which GUI features are scriptable and which need the GUI to acquire. Handles the Windows-only CLI from WSL by staging captures on the Windows side and copying them back. Use when the user asks to capture digital lines, set a sample rate or trigger, inspect PWM/UART/I2C/SPI timing, decode an IR remote or a serial bus, read an .atkdl project, or mentions 逻辑分析仪 / 时序采集 / 抓数字波形 / 协议解码 / 红外解码.
skills.short_description: ATK/DL16/DL32 logic analyzer capture, timing statistics, protocol decoding (IR/UART/I2C/SPI), ATKDL/VCD/CSV export

interface.short_description: Capture, decode and export digital timing on ATK-Logic analyzers
interface.default_prompt: Use $atk-logic to capture legal frequency/duration combinations, decode the result with the GUI's protocol decoders (IR, UART, I2C, SPI), and report timing facts or a VCD/CSV.

skills.name: mcu-debug
skills.description: Flash, verify and debug ARM Cortex-M firmware through DAPLink/CMSIS-DAP probes. Provides 51 subcommands for probe/target discovery, CMSIS-Packs, flashing, hardware and flash breakpoints, conditional breakpoints with on-hit scripts, DWARF CFI backtraces, C expression evaluation, SVD peripherals, RTOS threads, RTT, SWO/ITM, semihosting, multicore, DWT cycle counting, a board self-check and evidence recorder (`selfcheck`, `record`), a rule-based HardFault analyser with self-contained HTML reports, and a self-contained test entrypoint (`test`). Supports both pyOCD and probe-rs backends with automatic chip-name routing. On WSL it auto-detects Windows-side probes through usbipd and can attach them to the distro. Use when the user asks to flash or erase a board, attach a debugger, inspect registers/memory, set breakpoints, capture RTT/SWO output, or diagnose a crash/HardFault. Also builds SCMCU/PIC firmware with the bundled XC8 flow and drives the CACHIP USB HID programmer for CA51 touch MCUs (burning, touch calibration, firmware slots, downloader updates).
skills.short_description: Debug/flash Cortex-M, build XC8 firmware, burn/calibrate CACHIP touch MCUs

interface.short_description: Debug/flash Cortex-M, build XC8 firmware, burn/calibrate CACHIP touch MCUs
interface.default_prompt: Use $mcu-debug to flash or debug a Cortex-M target, build SCMCU/PIC firmware with XC8, or burn/calibrate a CACHIP CA51 touch MCU.

skills.name: oscilloscope
skills.description: Control bench oscilloscopes over LAN (SCPI socket) or USB (USBTMC/VISA) from any brand — Rigol, Keysight/Agilent, Tektronix, Siglent, LeCroy, Rohde & Schwarz, GW Instek, Yokogawa and generic SCPI instruments. Use this skill whenever the user mentions an oscilloscope, scope, SCPI, VISA, USBTMC, VXI-11, waveform capture, trigger setup, probe/channel configuration, screen capture, 示波器 / 抓波形 / 看波形 / 调触发 / 测频率 / 截图, or asks to inspect a signal on real hardware — even if they do not name the brand. Also use it for intermittent-fault monitoring (arm, wait, capture evidence) and for analyzing exported waveform CSV files. Bench questions are answered one intent per command (status, arm, watch, capture, monitor); the caller never composes SCPI.
skills.short_description: 多品牌示波器控制、抓波形、测量、截图与故障监视

interface.short_description: 多品牌示波器控制与波形采集
